# Fabric.js for the drawing prototype

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Fabric.js 6.9.0, MIT license. Copied from the official npm tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/fabric/-/fabric-6.9.0.tgz on 2026-11-10. Tarball integrity: `sha512-ILIbG4Us/41Z4rU8/gveN4Hb7NvgBorqV9xj+9Dl7YsXiyUPXdxV8+q5OvaNghmYzQoK1Am3m0wTvmovOxrJAg==`.

Only the standalone Studio design prototype loads this browser bundle. Production DSH packages and their dependency lockfile are unchanged. Object selection, transformations, free drawing, text and JSON serialization come from Fabric; project persistence and the surrounding UI are owned by the prototype. API reference: https://fabricjs.com/api/classes/canvas/.
